config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "c") == ""
  ex config_value("", "a") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    var name = ""
    var val = ""
    var seen = False
    for c in line.chars()
      if seen
        val = "\(val)\(c)"
      else
        if c == "="
          seen = True
        else
          name = "\(name)\(c)"
    if seen
      if name == key
        return val
  ""
